verdictProse:
Hostile validation verdict, admin PWA source candidate f70e8b4caba9f5c722348f9da6e7fae0adce7922, gate admin-pwa-source-round2 (staging readiness only). Timestamp 2026-10-28T21:04:05 local.

OverallVerdict DISAGREE. Accuracy 95. Completeness 94. Both are below 98, and the workspace-rules surface has three FAILs and the requested-claims surface one. PASS 36, FAIL 4, UNKNOWN 0 of 40.

What holds: the round1 product defect is fixed correctly. New profiles default private, and migration 012 recreates the public profile query with a guest-only filter inside the pre-paging subquery; otherwise it is identical to 002 and keeps its grants. The real PostgreSQL test seeds a 999-win legacy member with a public flag and proves both exclusion and pre-paging filtering (page 2 must be public-wins). The owner callback proves the admin is absent from the SQL projection. No other public projection exposes member identities. The planner keeps the recorded hosted prefix and appends 012 safely. All five TRX match the request hashes and their native JUnit case by case, with 0 failed and 0 skipped. Unit coverage is 61 of 61 files, and every lane started after the last edit relevant to it. Round1 F3, F4 and F5 are fixed: structured GA copies are on TR/TEST records with a new native edge, the adapter harness and fixtures are reproducible, and all four PWA browser cases reran. The one-time operator exception is recorded verbatim, scoped to the historical receipt only, and present in QBrain. DEC-11 is rewritten and unsatisfied. Nothing is claimed done or deployed.

Why DISAGREE:
G1 (medium, BDPv4): the deployment planner change in the GA-10 slice had no pre-implementation test or mock gate. The 20:26:59 run shows 5 hosting-schema tests and a red length assertion; the prefix test was added at 20:28:47, after the only TypeScript check (build 20:27:56). The project's own deployment plan requires mock-first tests before script code. Operator decision needed: a further exception or remediation.
G4 (medium, profile rule): the existing Node script tool scripts/hosting-schema.mjs was extended rather than retired, and no exception was found. Operator decision needed: authorize it or require a PowerShell port.
G2 (low, evidence): the binding manifest omits 35 tracked files, including the admin worker, next.config.ts and every [reference] route. Mitigated: all were unchanged since 437c501.
G3 (low, receipts): there is no analyzer receipt for the two adapter scripts; the reviewer's static check is clean.
I1 to I8 are informational: GA-02 has TEST-only carriage, GA-10 evidence text is stale, hosting record wording is stale, the 012 revision bump is unasserted, duplicate case names persist, QBrain read-time timestamps persist, a reviewer session-binding divergence was triaged, and the marker plugin version drifts.

Not claimed and still pending: applying 012 to staging and then production, live GitHub consent, standalone phone OAuth continuity, physical OS installation, hosted rollout and durability under power loss.
